## Overview of the Project

**Grave Analysis**: How do different factors influence the ratio of relatedness and unrelatedness in a collective tomb from Mycenaean times?

**Research Background**: The project investigates who was buried together in Mycenaean collective tombs using genetic and osteological data. The dataset provides initial insights into multi-generational burial organization and social belonging.

::: {style="text-align: center;"}
<img src="tombs.png" style="width: 60%;"/>
:::

## Description of data sets

-   **Survey**: Retrospective cross-sectional analysis with temporal parameters\
-   **Two burial sites**
    -   Amfissa (tholos)
    -   Elateia (chamber tombs): T31, T36, T46, T50, T56, T62, T67\
-   **Note**: T46, T56, and T62 are also grouped into one fictitious tomb
-   **Analyzed data**
    -   **Tomb parameters:** estimated individuals, sampling success, length of use …
    -   **Individual metadata:** individual ID, tomb, skeletal element, age …
    -   **Kinship results:** relationship type, kinship coefficient, SNP overlap …
